query: List all experimental groups and planned n per group (stratified by sex); clarify whether 150 mg/kg refers to each herb or the total blended extract and justify individual vs blend arms.

response.query: List all experimental groups and planned n per group (stratified by sex); clarify whether 150 mg/kg refers to each herb or the total blended extract and justify individual vs blend arms.
response.answer: Two experimental groups: one for individual herb at 150 mg/kg, one for blended extract at 150 mg/kg total. Each group has 50 participants stratified by sex. The blend is used to assess combined effects.
